name: geo-observability
description: AI search visibility (AEO/GEO) tracking with an observability layer, on Cloudflare Workers.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run test:scripts && npm run version:check && npm run infra:check && npm run build:docs && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir .tmp/dist && wrangler deploy --dry-run --env staging --outdir .tmp/dist-staging && wrangler deploy --dry-run --config edge/wrangler.jsonc --outdir .tmp/dist-edge
scripts.seed:demo: node scripts/seed-demo.mjs .tmp/seed-demo.sql && wrangler d1 execute geo-observability --remote --file .tmp/seed-demo.sql
scripts.seed:demo:local: node scripts/seed-demo.mjs .tmp/seed-demo.sql && wrangler d1 execute geo-observability --local --persist-to .wrangler/state --file .tmp/seed-demo.sql
scripts.db:migrate:staging: wrangler d1 migrations apply geo-observability-staging --remote --env staging
